{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Textured wool-blend blazer with a notched lapel, relaxed fit cut to the hip, deep emerald green (#04332f), heavy wool blend.
Silk-chiffon blouse with a subtle cowl neck and gathered waist, midi length ending just above the knee, burnt orange (#d35400), lightweight silk chiffon.
High-waisted tailored trousers with a slight kickpleat, straight leg cut through the thigh to an ankle-length hem, charcoal grey (#36454f), stretch wool twill.
Pointed-toe leather pumps with a moderate heel, sleek silhouette, matte black finish (#1c1c1c), smooth calfskin leather.
Delicate gold-plated pendant necklace on an 18-inch chain and thin stackable bangles in brushed silver metal.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance for an autumn evening restaurant date by blending structured sophistication with warm, romantic tones that complement her complexion. The emerald green blazer provides a polished outer layer suitable for the cooler season while the burnt orange blouse adds a vibrant pop of color that feels inviting and personal. Tailored trousers ensure comfort and ease of movement throughout the dinner, avoiding the stiffness of a full suit while maintaining an elegant silhouette. Overall, the combination of textures and colors creates a look that is distinctly dressed up for the occasion yet remains approachable enough for a first or early-stage romantic outing."}
